Prototype disclaimer (fictional demo)

All restaurants, nonprofits, drivers, and donations are fictional and for demonstration only. RescueRoute helps participating businesses organize food-donation records that may support their food-recovery reporting and sustainability efforts — it does not guarantee SB 1383 compliance. Users must follow all applicable food-safety rules and local requirements. Federal Good Samaritan food-donation protections are general information only, not legal advice.
